# Documentation

## Purpose

Keep specs, architecture notes, and operational docs aligned with implementation.

## Inputs

- Approved decisions
- Code and test changes
- Review outcomes

## Outputs

- Updated docs with concise rationale
- Change log summary

## Procedure

1. Update only affected sections.
2. Keep behavior descriptions synchronized with tests and contracts.
3. Reference official MCP docs when documenting external framework behavior.
4. Record unresolved documentation gaps in progress memory.
